text:
anya: quick sync  proposal: make the default for new API keys project-scoped and show "effective_project" in the console keys table. require an explicit "Org key" checkbox for org-wide keys to reduce accidental cross-project billing spikes.

ben: +1. How do we treat legacy org keys? customers still rely on them.

anya: legacy keys unchanged. routing precedence: (1) key.project if set -> route, (2) key.scope==org -> org route, (3) if org flagged strict -> reject ambiguous calls with 401.

cait: telemetry needs: add access log fields `effective_project` and `declared_scope`, and a metric `auth.effective_project_breakdown` for dashboards. We'll need to backfill and compute historical deltas to validate migration impact.

ben: quota semantics? if an org key would exceed a per-project quota, do we deny or let org bucket continue? short term: keep org keys on org bucket. console shows per-project estimate. long term: offer auto-split using a `X-Redwood-Project-Hint` header.

anya: rollout: feature flag for new-key default + small canary opt-ins via support. enable audit logs and an alert for unexpected quota drops.

cait: UI idea: key row shows pill `proj:<id>` or `org` and a "simulate switch" action that backtests 30d usage and shows estimated token delta. I'll mock Grafana and console screenshots.

ben: add Prometheus alert for sudden shifts in `auth.effective_project` distribution per org (e.g., >25% shift in 1h). saw this bite us before.

ops-bot: ticket AUTH-4021 created: "default project-scoped keys + telemetry" assigned to anya, ben, cait.

anya: action items: @ben - RFC for routing/quota semantics; @cait - telemetry schema + dashboard mocks; @anya - migration UX + console copy. Target: RFC + mocks in 7 days.

ben: starting RFC outline now.

cait: will upload mock panels and example queries later today.

anya: include SDK header sample for future auto-splitting:`X-Redwood-Project-Hint: proj-abc123` and diagnostic event `auth.routing_change_candidate` for keys that match one project 95%+ over 7d.

ben: good idea. will capture in RFC.

ops-bot: ticket AUTH-4021 updated: due_date set to 7d.
